## Video-Catcher 0.9.2: updated libraries

Video-Catcher works exactly as in 0.9.1. **Only the window changed; the extension stays as it is.**

- **Security:** updated `golang.org/x/crypto` to 0.59.0, which fixes GO-2026-5932. Video-Catcher does not use the affected code, the update keeps it out of the program anyway. `golang.org/x/net`, `x/sys` and `x/text` are updated along with it.
- **README:** a clear disclaimer: Video-Catcher is free hobby software without any warranty, and you are responsible for what you download.

Files: `VideoCatcher.exe` (or `VideoCatcher-arm64.exe`) and the extension (`VideoCatcher-extension-chromium.zip`, `VideoCatcher-extension-firefox.zip` or `.xpi`).

The files are not digitally signed yet; Windows SmartScreen may warn. Every file is built by GitHub Actions from this repository, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists their checksums.
